subject: social
name: Social Studies
title: Pre-K Social Studies: Self, Family & Community
overview: Pre-K Social Studies introduces young scholars to civic responsibilities, geographic mapping, economic needs versus wants, and the historic stories that shape our shared community.
competencies: Explain the necessity of rules, laws, and collaborative citizenship in democratic communities.
Read and create simple maps to locate geographic features, cities, and landmarks.
Differentiate between producers, consumers, goods, and services in basic market exchanges.
Analyze primary artifacts and historical traditions celebrating American cultural diversity.

modules.title: All About Me & My Family
modules.description: Celebrating personal identity, feelings, family customs, and cultural heritage.

topics.title: Who Am I? Feelings & Uniqueness
topics.description: Expressing emotions, identifying personal strengths, and practicing empathy.

topics.title: Families & Special Traditions
topics.description: Sharing family traditions, roles, and diverse family structures.

modules.title: Classroom Friends & Community Helpers
modules.description: Learning cooperation, sharing, classroom rules, and neighborhood helpers.

topics.title: Cooperation & Sharing Rules
topics.description: Taking turns, resolving conflicts peacefully, and working together in groups.

topics.title: Community Helpers at Work
topics.description: Discovering the roles of firefighters, doctors, teachers, mail carriers, and sanitation workers.
